confidence_notes: Food/drink anchors come from search-result summaries citing Numbeo (mid-range 3-course dinner for two ~EUR 60), Expatistan, Hikersbay and local guides; meals, cappuccino (~EUR 3.1-3.2) and beer (~EUR 2.5-3.5) are fairly consistent. Cocktail (EUR 6-12 across sources) and restaurant wine by the glass (EUR 3-9, no reliable index) are less certain; cocktail ~2.7x and wine ~1.4x the beer price were used as cross-checks. EUR figures were converted at an assumed ~1.16 USD/EUR, not separately sourced. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July 2026 from general knowledge, with no listings or booking pages inspected.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant and bar price levels are close to Prague and Budapest and below nearby Vienna. Accommodation is benchmarked holistically against summer rates in those cities, with Bratislava priced below Vienna and Prague and near Budapest.
